title: The Space menu hid tabs behind a More popup; the owner wants one horizontal scroll rail with Manage pinned in place

source.ref: Owner request 2026-10-06 (Space page tab bar screenshot)

detail: Owner ruling 2026-10-06 reverses the LIVE-529 fold. The Space menu showed four tabs and folded the rest into a More <details> that stayed hanging open over the page. Now the <nav> holds two children: a rail (flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-x-auto, faded edges via admin-subnav-scroll so a cut pill reads as more to scroll) carrying EVERY tab, and the Manage entry pinned outside it (shrink-0) so it never scrolls with the tabs. The view stays hook-free and server-renderable (LIVE-522). lib/spaces/profile-nav-condense.ts is deleted, having no callers. The probe reads the view: no details fold, a rail that scrolls, the tab list inside the rail, and Manage after the rail closes with its own shrink floor.

verify.note: Fails if the menu folds tabs behind a details popup, if the rail stops being a shrinkable horizontal scroller, or if Manage renders inside the rail.
